chapterInfo.content:
24
Boasetɔ ne asomdwoeɛpɛ
1Mma wo ho mmpere wo, abɔnefoɔ ho,
na mma wo kɔn nnnɔ sɛ wo ne wɔn bɛtena,
2na wɔn akoma dwene ɔsɛeɛ ho,
na wɔn ano ka mmusuo.
3Wɔde nyansa na ɛsi dan,
na wɔde nhunumu ma no gyina,
4 # Mmb 31.10-31 na wɔnam nimdeɛ so de ahodeɛ aboɔdenneɛ afɛfɛdeɛ nyinaa
hyɛ mpia mama.
5Ɔbarima nyansafoɔ wɔ ahoɔden,
na ɔba nimdefoɔ ma ne tumi mu yɛ den.
6 # Mmb 20.18; 11.14 Atɛmpa na fa kyekyere wo sa,
na nkonim wɔ agyinatufoɔ dodoɔ mu.
7Nyansa korɔn papa ma ogyimifoɔ,
ɔmmue n’ano kuro pono mu.
8Deɛ ɔdwene bɔneyɛ ho no,
wɔfrɛ no ɔkɔtwebrɛfoɔ.
9Agyimisɛm tirimbɔ yɛ bɔne,
na nnipa akyiwadeɛ ne ɔfɛdifoɔ.
10Wo nsa mu go ahohiahia da mu a,
w’ahoɔden sua.
11 # Hiob 29.12; Dwom 82.4 Gye wɔn a wɔtwe wɔn kɔ owuo mu,
na sɛ wɔtɔ ekum kwan so ntintan a, sianka wɔn ɛ.
12 # Mmb 16.2; 1 Sa 16.7; Rom 2.6 Sɛ wose: Hwɛ, na yɛnnim yei a,
deɛ ɔkari akoma no nhunu mu,
na deɛ ɔkora wo kra no nnim anaa?
Na ɔbɛtua onipa ka sɛdeɛ ne nneyɛɛ teɛ.
13Di ɛwoɔ, me ba, na ɛyɛ,
ne ɛwoɔkyɛm a ɛyɛ wo dodom dɛ;
14 # Mmb 23.18 saa na bu nyansa ma wo kra,
sɛ wohunu a, ɛso akatua bɛba daakye,
na wɔrentwa w’anidasoɔ no ntwene.
15Ɔbɔnefoɔ, ntɛ ɔteneneeni fie,
na nsɛe ne homebea.
16 # Hiob 5.19; Dwom 37.24 Na mprɛnson na ɔteneneeni hwe ase na ɔsɔreɛ,
na abɔnefoɔ deɛ, amanehunu hwe wɔn ase.
17 # Hiob 31.29 Wo tamfo hwe ase a, mma w’ani nnnye,
na ɔwatiri a, mma w’akoma nnni ahurisie,
18na AWURADE anhunu, na anyɛ n’ani so bɔne,
na wannane n’abufuo amfiri ne so.
19 # Mmb 3.31; Dwom 37.1; 73.3 Nha wo ho nnebɔneyɛfoɔ ho,
na mma w’ani mmmere abɔnefoɔ.
20 # Mmb 13.9 Na akyire asefoɔ nni hɔ mma ɔbɔne,
abɔnefoɔ kanea bɛdum.
21 # 1 Pe 2.17 Me ba, suro AWURADE ne ɔhene,
mfa wo ho mmɔ atuatefoɔ ho,
22 # Rom 13.2 na mpofirim na amaneɛ firi wɔn hɔ bɛba,
na ɔsɛeɛ a ɛbɛfiri wɔn baanu hɔ no,
hwan na ɔnim?
23 # Lew 19.15 Yeinom nso yɛ anyansafoɔ dea:
Atemmuo mu animhwɛ nyɛ.
24Deɛ ɔse ɔbɔnefoɔ sɛ:
Wotene, no, aman bɛdome no,
na amanaman bɛkyiri no.
25Na wɔn a wɔtwe aso no bɛdi yie,
na wɔn so na nhyira pa bɛba.
26 # Mmb 15.23 Deɛ ɔma mmuaeɛ pa no
te sɛ deɛ ɔfe ano.
27Siesie w’adwuma wɔ baabi,
na toto wo biribiara w’asase so;
na ɛno akyiri no woakyekyere wo fie.
28 # Mmb 19.5 Nni wo yɔnko ho adanse hunu,
na mfa w’ano nnaadaa.
29 # Mmb 20.22 Nka sɛ: Sɛ ɔyɛɛ me no,
saa ara na mɛyɛ no,
mɛtua no deɛ wayɛ no so ka.
30Mesianee ɔbarima kwadwofoɔ afuo
ne onipa a ɔnni tire bobeturo ho,
31na hwɛ, na ne nyinaa afu nsansono,
na ahyehyewonsa akata ani,
na ɛho aboɔ fasuo abubu agu.
32Ɛnna mehwɛeɛ, na medwenee ho yie,
mehunui, na mefaa mu nyansa.
33 # Mmb 6.9-11 Nna kakra, nkotɔ kakra,
nsa a mɛpono mada kakra,
34 # Mmb 10.4 ɛnna wo hia nam so bɛba sɛ odwotwafoɔ,
ne w’ahokyere sɛ ɛkyɛmkurani.

pageProps.chapterText:
Mma wo ho mmpere wo, abɔnefoɔ ho,
na mma wo kɔn nnnɔ sɛ wo ne wɔn bɛtena,
na wɔn akoma dwene ɔsɛeɛ ho,
na wɔn ano ka mmusuo.
Wɔde nyansa na ɛsi dan,
na wɔde nhunumu ma no gyina,
na wɔnam nimdeɛ so de ahodeɛ aboɔdenneɛ afɛfɛdeɛ nyinaa
hyɛ mpia mama.
Ɔbarima nyansafoɔ wɔ ahoɔden,
na ɔba nimdefoɔ ma ne tumi mu yɛ den.
Atɛmpa na fa kyekyere wo sa,
na nkonim wɔ agyinatufoɔ dodoɔ mu.
Nyansa korɔn papa ma ogyimifoɔ,
ɔmmue n’ano kuro pono mu.
Deɛ ɔdwene bɔneyɛ ho no,
wɔfrɛ no ɔkɔtwebrɛfoɔ.
Agyimisɛm tirimbɔ yɛ bɔne,
na nnipa akyiwadeɛ ne ɔfɛdifoɔ.
Wo nsa mu go ahohiahia da mu a,
w’ahoɔden sua.
Gye wɔn a wɔtwe wɔn kɔ owuo mu,
na sɛ wɔtɔ ekum kwan so ntintan a, sianka wɔn ɛ.
Sɛ wose: Hwɛ, na yɛnnim yei a,
deɛ ɔkari akoma no nhunu mu,
na deɛ ɔkora wo kra no nnim anaa?
Na ɔbɛtua onipa ka sɛdeɛ ne nneyɛɛ teɛ.
Di ɛwoɔ, me ba, na ɛyɛ,
ne ɛwoɔkyɛm a ɛyɛ wo dodom dɛ;
saa na bu nyansa ma wo kra,
sɛ wohunu a, ɛso akatua bɛba daakye,
na wɔrentwa w’anidasoɔ no ntwene.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ, ntɛ ɔteneneeni fie,
na nsɛe ne homebea.
Na mprɛnson na ɔteneneeni hwe ase na ɔsɔreɛ,
na abɔnefoɔ deɛ, amanehunu hwe wɔn ase.
Wo tamfo hwe ase a, mma w’ani nnnye,
na ɔwatiri a, mma w’akoma nnni ahurisie,
na AWURADE anhunu, na anyɛ n’ani so bɔne,
na wannane n’abufuo amfiri ne so.
Nha wo ho nnebɔneyɛfoɔ ho,
na mma w’ani mmmere abɔnefoɔ.
Na akyire asefoɔ nni hɔ mma ɔbɔne,
abɔnefoɔ kanea bɛdum.
Me ba, suro AWURADE ne ɔhene,
mfa wo ho mmɔ atuatefoɔ ho,
na mpofirim na amaneɛ firi wɔn hɔ bɛba,
na ɔsɛeɛ a ɛbɛfiri wɔn baanu hɔ no,
hwan na ɔnim?
Yeinom nso yɛ anyansafoɔ dea:
Atemmuo mu animhwɛ nyɛ.
Deɛ ɔse ɔbɔnefoɔ sɛ:
Wotene, no, aman bɛdome no,
na amanaman bɛkyiri no.
Na wɔn a wɔtwe aso no bɛdi yie,
na wɔn so na nhyira pa bɛba.
Deɛ ɔma mmuaeɛ pa no
te sɛ deɛ ɔfe ano.
Siesie w’adwuma wɔ baabi,
na toto wo biribiara w’asase so;
na ɛno akyiri no woakyekyere wo fie.
Nni wo yɔnko ho adanse hunu,
na mfa w’ano nnaadaa.
Nka sɛ: Sɛ ɔyɛɛ me no,
saa ara na mɛyɛ no,
mɛtua no deɛ wayɛ no so ka.
Mesianee ɔbarima kwadwofoɔ afuo
ne onipa a ɔnni tire bobeturo ho,
na hwɛ, na ne nyinaa afu nsansono,
na ahyehyewonsa akata ani,
na ɛho aboɔ fasuo abubu agu.
Ɛnna mehwɛeɛ, na medwenee ho yie,
mehunui, na mefaa mu nyansa.
Nna kakra, nkotɔ kakra,
nsa a mɛpono mada kakra,
ɛnna wo hia nam so bɛba sɛ odwotwafoɔ,
ne w’ahokyere sɛ ɛkyɛmkurani.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
